ConnectionStrings._comment: Set via user-secrets or the AQSAT_DB_CONNECTION environment variable — a real credential never belongs in the repo. One-time setup: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Default" "Server=localhost;Database=Aqsat;User Id=sa;Password=<yours>;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true" --project src/Aqsat.Api

Encryption._comment: Set via user-secrets (32-byte base64 key, e.g. from: openssl rand -base64 32). Never commit a real key.

Jwt._comment: Set via user-secrets (at least 48 bytes, e.g. from: openssl rand -base64 48). Never commit a real signing key.

Security._comment: DEV/TEST ONLY perf knob â€” production keeps the default 600,000 (OWASP floor). The test suite performs hundreds of logins against one shared LocalDB; full-cost hashing there adds minutes for no coverage gain.

ApiIr._comment: AllowPaidEndpoints stays false until an agency's real api.ir key is configured — every call routes to /api/Sandbox/Echo until then.

Platform._comment: One-time secret for POST /api/platform/bootstrap-owner. Set via user-secrets, rotate after the real owner account exists.

Portal._comment: Base URL the SMS'd customer link is built from — the public frontend, not the API.
